about: Log of every change from the OCR baseline to book.md. Written by corrections.py only; do not edit by hand. Replaying the 'edit' entries (find -> replace, in order) on the baseline must reproduce book.md exactly.
lineage: ocr/md/pNN.md: raw TurboOCR output per PDF page
book.ocr-original.md: pipeline.py build output from those pages (line-wrap hyphen joins, running footers and page comments handled by the pipeline); frozen, sha256 pinned below, never edited
book.md: the hand-editable source of the EPUB and the SE edition; every change from the baseline is an entry below

baseline.what: book.md as generated by pipeline.py build from the OCR pages, before any hand or SymSpell edit
